fields.why: Table 1 chi-square p-values test survivor vs non-survivor across 3-level SPD margins (rule 2), and Table 3 ranks 3+ SPD groups; groupwise entries are warranted.
Table 1 chi-squares cover 3-level age, race/ethnicity and SES (education, insurance, income, employment); Table 3 and text rank the same dimensions. Sex has only 2 levels.

Table 1 composition chi-squares are omnibus tests (rule 2); Table 3 adjusted predicted percentages by race, age and insurance are ranked with CIs but no tests, so side by side. The mechanical flag is a false hit: the chi-square belongs to Table 1, not to the Table 3 results.
